# 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' tops box office for 6th straight weekend

2:47

'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' hits theaters

Shane Anthony Sinclair/Getty Images

ByShafiq Najib

September 06, 2026, 9:12 PM

"Spider-Man: Brand New Day" is continuing its blockbuster run at the box office.

The latest "Spider-Man" film, starring Tom Holland, remained No. 1 at the domestic box office for the sixth consecutive weekend, bringing in an estimated $18 million from Friday through Sunday. [...] Through Aug. 31, the domestic box office totaled $4.6 billion for the summer, a 26.1% increase from 2025, according to Rentrak data reported by The Associated Press.
